AgentDojo_calibrated.threshold_source: 95th percentile of held-out AgentDojo benign calibration set (n=62)
AgentDojo_calibrated.note: Threshold recalibrated from internal synthetic distribution to AgentDojo benign distribution. FPR measured on held-out test benign set (n=62), not calibration set.

AgentDojo_note: IMPORTANT: The uncalibrated AgentDojo result (FPR=1.0) reflects threshold-transfer failure when applying τ=1.1253 (calibrated on TinyLlama/ShareGPT synthetic traffic) directly to the AgentDojo benign distribution without recalibration. This is expected and documented in §5 as an out-of-distribution calibration requirement. The canonical result is AgentDojo_calibrated: threshold recalibrated to the AgentDojo benign distribution (95th percentile of n=62 held-out benign episodes), yielding ROC-AUC=1.0, Recall=1.0, FPR=0.0 on the held-out test set. Per-deployment threshold calibration is a stated design requirement of CPSI.
